instruction: In my file system, add the prefix "YYYY_MM_DD_" to all file names in the ~/my_downloads/ directory, based on their creation dates, and then move all files not from this year to ~/archive/.
notes: The real number of files in ~/my_downloads/ is only known after show_directory, so the problem instantiates one representative file per category (created this year -> stays in ~/my_downloads/ with the YYYY_MM_DD_ prefix; created earlier -> prefixed and moved to ~/archive/); at runtime the show_file/move_file pair is repeated for every listed file. Static init facts encode the task rule: created-in-year gives each file's creation year (discovered via show_file), year-destination maps the current year to the downloads directory and earlier years to the archive directory, and prefixed-path gives the single correct destination path for a file in its destination directory. move_file is only applicable after the directory was listed, the file's creation date was read, and the current date was fetched (phone.get_current_date_and_time, which needs no login). renamed prevents re-moving a file; since move_file only admits the correct destination, (renamed f) is equivalent to f being at its correct prefixed path, which is why supervisor-complete-task checks renamed for the two distinct file records (the two extra file parameters are task records, not API arguments) and the goal additionally pins the final paths. in-directory records the initial listing membership used to gate show_file and is intentionally static. The supervisor person object is declared for completeness; the login username comes from supervisor.show_profile.

plan: (file-system-move-file path-my-downloads-file-prior-year path-archive-prefixed-file-prior-year file-system-token file-prior-year year-before-2023 dir-archive)
(file-system-move-file path-my-downloads-file-this-year path-my-downloads-prefixed-file-this-year file-system-token file-this-year year-2023 dir-my-downloads)
